content.title: Western Digital and Seagate Remain Buys Even as Stocks on Remarkable Runs, Citi Says
content.summary: Wall Street continues to boost its outlook for data-storage companies like  Western Digital  and  Seagate Technology Holdings  amid a surge in demand for cloud computing and artificial intelligence.  Citi  reiterated Buy ratings for both stocks, as well as competitor  Sandisk  in a research note Monday.  The firm lifted its price target for  Western Digital  to $135 from $110; for  Seagate  to $250 from $215; and for  Sandisk  to $150 from $125.
